name: Absorbent Cosmic Towel
description: An incredibly useful towel that, according to Terry, you should never be without

interactions.examine: This is a large, soft towel woven from cosmic cotton. It's incredibly absorbent and surprisingly durable. Terry Towelson sold you this, insisting that a towel is the most useful thing any space traveler can carry. You're not entirely sure why, but Terry seemed very certain about it. The tag reads: 'DON'T PANIC' in large, friendly letters.
interactions.take: You pick up the cosmic towel. It's soft, clean, and folds surprisingly small. Terry was right - you do feel more prepared with a towel.
interactions.use: You unfold the cosmic towel. It's remarkably versatile - you could dry yourself, use it as a blanket, signal for help, or apparently, according to Terry, 'countless other applications limited only by your imagination and the structural integrity of cloth.'
